raw_rows_seen: s100vote, 10 rows read (3 problems x 4 samples, plus 4 kept merge328 problems and 3 d1 problems below): step-100 problem 0 has four right answers written two ways ('\left(3, \frac{\pi}{2}\right)' and '(3, \frac{\pi}{2})'), grouped as one by the team vote; problem 18 has three samples on the shared wrong value 56 and one right 28 (gold 28), so the vote loses: shared wrong values exist at step 100; problem 5 has one sample with no answer (abstains) and '42 inches' grouped with '42'.

merge328: kept problems are mostly 3 right and 1 wrong (37 of 88), where merging cannot change the vote; problem 66 (673, 16011, 721, 721; gold 721) is the type where differing wrong answers matter. The kept problems' own wrong-pair agreement is 0.146 of 55 pairs, below the all-hard328 0.218 of 257 the adversary uses, so the measured D sits between the shared-attractor value (0.102) and the independent value (0.139).

d1: problems 29 and 57 are 0 of 4 for edit, RL and base, and the cap32 base sample finishes wrong (240 vs gold 244; 4060 vs 928); problem 61 is right for RL in 2 of 4 and the edit in 0 of 4. E and R rest on 68 and 74 right samples of 480, B on 6 of 120.
